_comment: Settings shared by every recreated URL method. The sampling caps and the threshold rule are the defaults of our own URL training (ml/url/train.py: --cap 100000, PhreshPhish x2.5, val cap/4 and PhreshPhish = cap, --target-fpr 0.002), so ours and the recreations are trained and thresholded identically. Nothing here was chosen by looking at a test set.

phreshphish_table4._source: Dalton et al., PhreshPhish, arXiv 2507.10854 v2, Table 4 (URL + HTML input); keys are phishing base rates in %

grambeddings_accuracy._source: Bozkir et al., GramBeddings, Computers & Security 2023, abstract: accuracy on the GramBeddings 800k dataset
